Salman Khan's film 'Maatrubhumi' cleared for release after changes

The government has granted clearance for the release of Salman Khan's war drama film, 'Maatrubhumi', after modifications were made to portray China in a positive light. The film is now set to be released in theaters, though a specific release date has not yet been announced.
